reference.note: The local .local snapshot remains alpha.1 and was not edited or used as the rc.1 runtime. Rc.1 source audit used an external cleanable checkout.

upstreamReview.runtimeDecision: 0.1.2-rc.1 is the sole main development runtime. The official 242-package public npm family is exact-version and integrity pinned; alpha.4 is not retained as a compatibility path.
upstreamReview.ownershipImpact: Agent hooks, llm/stream, tools/pre-execute, SessionEvent.ignorable, JSONL persistence, RemoteError/controllers, shipped presets, openai-codex authorization, usage, compaction, Subagent/cancel, history pagination, Inspector eventSource and AppFrame/details seams are unchanged from alpha.4. Rc.1 adds compatible storage-domain versions and backup-and-skip handling for disposable malformed projection-cache records; session_projcache v5 accepts v3/v4 and preserves old lineage semantics. Aezy required no runtime seam adaptation and copied no upstream kernel.
